rule: Correct means no factual contradiction or unsupported claim. Fully adequate additionally covers all required details. Citation acceptance is not answer scoring. Errors stay in the denominator.

networkx-easy: Yields a node set for each component
Skips graph nodes already in global seen
Calls _plain_bfs with graph, remaining unseen-node count, and start node
Updates global seen with the component before yielding
networkx-medium: Yields lists of zero-in-degree generation nodes, despite docstring calling them sets
Multigraph decrement uses parallel-edge count len(G[node][child]), otherwise one
KeyError on the child in-degree map raises chained RuntimeError
A remaining in-degree map after the loop raises NetworkXUnfeasible for a cycle or graph change
networkx-hard: Invalid method raises ValueError before weight=None can force unweighted mode
Valid method with weight=None becomes unweighted
Target-only directed graph is reversed with copy=False
Unweighted uses single_source_shortest_path starting at target
Dijkstra uses single_source_dijkstra_path at target with weight passed
Bellman-Ford uses single_source_bellman_ford_path at target with weight passed
Reverses each returned path list back toward the original target
Returns a mapping keyed by original source nodes
networkx-guard: Abstains from inventing private live graph data
